symbol-helper.$description: Single-family system for every text role: 14px navigation, 18px links and supporting copy, 20px interface labels, 24px card kickers, 34px introductions, 50px testimonial statements and arrows, 80px display headlines, and 480px decorative glyph-scale type. Keeping all weights at 400 makes scale and the font's sharply calligraphic serif shapes do the hierarchy work rather than boldness.
